spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sewn, woven.
E.
वि before उत woven; also व्यूत.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Woven.
E.
वि before ऊत the same.

f. (-तिः)
Sewing, weaving.
E.
वि before ऊय to weave, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.; also व्यूति.

f. (-तिः)
1 Weaving.
E.
वि before वेञ् to weave, aff. क्तिन् and व changed to ऊ.

m. (-मः)
Inverted order, irregular arrangement.
E.
वि and उत् before क्रम order.

n. (-नं)
1 Independence, following one's own inclination.
2 Opposition, contradiction, doing that which is prohibited.
3 Obstruction, prohibition, hindering or opposing any one.
4 Completion of religious contemplation, the end. of a period of abstraction.
E.
वि and उत् before स्था to stay or be, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Science, learning, conversancy with or proficience in literature or science.
2 Formation of words, derivation, etymology.
E.
वि and उत् before पद to go, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Learned, studied, conversant or proficient in literature.
2 Completed, finished.
3 Derived, formed as a derivative word.
4 Generated, begotten.
E.
वि and उत् before पद to go, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Put off, thrown aside, (especially as feeling or affection.)
E.
वि and उट् before अस to throw, क्त aff.

ind.
Having thrown off or put away, (as desire, feeling, &c.)
E.
वि and उद before अस to throw, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-सः)
1 Indifference to, disregard for.
2 Making ill or unprofitable use of any thing, throwing away.
E.
वि and उद before अस to throw, घञ् aff.

m. (-शः)
Pretext, deception, plausible but false council.
E.
वि priv., उपदेश advice.

r. 10th cl. (व्युषयति)
To abandon, to reject.

(इर) व्युसिर r. 4th cl. (व्युस्यति)
To leave, to abandon.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1

Burned.
2

Dawned, become daylight or dawn.
n. (-ष्टं)
1 Dawn, break of day.
2

Day.
3

Fruit, consequence.
E.
वि before वस to abide, aff. क्त, and व changed to उ, or व्युष to burn, when it is more properly read व्युष्ट.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Fruit, consequence.
2 Increase, prosperity.
3 Praise.
E.
वि and वस to abide, aff. क्तिन्, and व changed to उ.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Arranged, arrayed, placed in order or array.
2 Compact, firm, well-knit.
3 Large, great.
E.
वि before वह to bear, &c., aff. क्त.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Armed, mailed.
E.
व्यूढ arranged, and कङ्कट mail.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Broad-chested.
E.
व्यूढ, उरस् the breast, कन् added.

f. (-ढिः)
Array, orderly arrangement or disposition.
E.
वि before वह to bear, or ऊह to reason, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-हः)
1 Military array, the arrangement of troops in various positions; as दण्डव्यूहः the array in line, भोगव्यूहः in column, मण्डलव्यूहः in circle, असंहतव्यूहः in mixed order; also various fanciful forms, as the शकटः or car-shape, मकरः or marine monster-like, पताका flag-shape, &c.
2 A flock, a multitude.
3 Logic, reasoning.
4 Making, manufacture.
5 The body.
E.
वि before ऊह to reason, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Arraying, array, arrangement.
2 Structure of the body, disposition of the members.
E.
वि before ऊह to reason, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-र्ष्णिः)
The rear of an army.
E.
व्यूह array, and पार्ष्णि the heel or back.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Throwing into disorder, breaking an array.
E.
व्यूह, and भङ्ग breaking.

m. (-दः)
Piercing or breaking an array.
E.
व्यूह, and भेद breaking.
